start: Live workout open, phone storage full

steps.action: Tick a set (the workout saves itself)
user_sees: A calm banner at the top: 'Couldn't save — your phone's storage may be full. Free some space; we'll keep trying.'
must_not: A code or a stack trace
The banner taking taps meant for Minimise or the back arrow

steps.action: Free some space and tick another set
user_sees: The banner goes on the next save that works
must_not: The banner staying after saves work
Sets lost

start: Live workout open, storage full, member taps Finish

steps.action: Tap Finish
user_sees: 'Couldn't finish your workout — your phone's storage may be full. It's still open: free some space, then tap Finish again.'
The workout still open
must_not: 'We'll keep trying' for a Finish that is not retried
The workout closed or lost

steps.action: Free space, tap Finish again
user_sees: The workout finishes; the banner goes
must_not: The banner left after the finish
Two saved workouts

start: Editing a past workout, a save error that is not storage

steps.action: Tap Save changes
user_sees: 'Couldn't save your changes. They're still open — tap Save changes again.'
must_not: The edits thrown away
The banner gone after an autosave works

start: Live workout, saves fail for a reason other than storage

steps.action: Keep logging sets
user_sees: 'Couldn't save your workout. We'll keep trying.'
must_not: The storage-full words when storage is fine
A red error pop-up that needs a tap

start: Finish failed, banner shows the Finish line

steps.action: Log another set; the autosave works
user_sees: The Finish line stays
must_not: The banner cleared by the autosave while Finish still needs a tap

steps.action: Discard the workout
user_sees: The banner goes
must_not: The banner left on the next workout

steps.action: Do step 1 of "'Couldn't save' banner" on the phone with the watch connected; look at both. Then do it from the watch.

start: Live workout open, phone storage full

user_sees: A calm banner at the top: 'Couldn't save — your phone's storage may be full. Free some space; we'll keep trying.'
must_not: A code or a stack trace

steps.action: Close the app (swipe it away) at step 1 of "'Couldn't save' banner", then open it again.

note: App closed while saves fail: the draft may be older than the screen
